validation_rules: The reusable composition shall instantiate exactly one trecap_core_top and one trecap_telemetry_top.
The composition shall accept a normalized ready/valid sample stream and shall expose the real core y stream, status, metrics, taps, and telemetry record stream.
Core sample, frame, and unique-bin taps shall bind directly to telemetry and shall have no ready path back into the core.
record_ready_i shall backpressure only telemetry record handling and shall not affect sample_ready_o or y_ready_i.
WAVE, SPEC64 or SPEC129, METRICS, and STATUS shall be gated by the generated global and per-packet controls.
PEAKS and DEBUG shall remain reserved-disabled, and TSPEC_DISABLED shall suppress spectrum records.
A packetizer that cannot accept an observation shall drop telemetry rather than stall the core.

A source observation-epoch reset shall discard partial collections and suppress new admission; an already-selected record finishes atomically, unselected candidates drain locally, and the packet FIFO is not reset.
The scheduler shall preserve record atomicity and shall latch local drain ownership for every disabled or illegal candidate until that candidate's final beat produces one counted drop event.
The packet FIFO shall admit complete records and shall preserve the active output head while it is presented downstream.
Pre-writer packetizer, scheduler, and FIFO drops shall be counted separately from DDR-writer drops.
tap_frame.valid, status_tick_i, and metrics_tick_i shall never be treated as core-configuration safe boundaries.
Core metrics clear shall be applied only by the composition caller at a true core frame boundary or structural core idle boundary.
In the DE1-SoC path, the source/core layer's safe clear_metrics_apply_pulse_o event shall drive both the core and telemetry metric epochs; the raw CSR request shall not clear telemetry directly.
Any source discontinuity or standalone datapath reset that clears core metrics shall also clear telemetry-owned eligible-bin aggregates.
Telemetry soft reset shall be a synchronous formatter, scheduler, and packet-FIFO clear in clk; it shall not derive an asynchronous reset or reset or clear the mathematical core.
Every telemetry child rst_n shall remain driven by canonical rst_n; telemetry_soft_reset_i shall suppress admission and drive only synchronous formatter_reset_i or flush_i controls.
Telemetry soft clear shall preserve metrics aggregates, whose epoch remains controlled separately by metrics_clear_i.
STATUS sample_count and frame_count shall come from explicit authoritative core counters and shall not be reconstructed from delayed tap indices.
CSR-visible OVERFLOW_FLAGS shall be set only by new-fault events and shall remain clearable through W1C.
Step-8-owned telemetry configuration and writer histories shall not manufacture a second new-fault event while the underlying fault episode remains continuously asserted.
The packet-FIFO sticky level shall be exposed separately and shall not be continuously ORed into the CSR-visible sticky set path.
Writer overflow event history shall re-arm after the source deasserts so a later same-bit recurrence can set CSR-visible OVERFLOW_FLAGS again.
trecap_telemetry_top.u_packet_fifo shall be the sole owner of the formatted record output stream.
The pure telemetry filelist shall exclude core RTL and the composed wrapper; the composed filelist shall contain both layers in dependency order.
The DE1-SoC path shall not instantiate the reusable composition behind a source/core layer that already owns trecap_core_top.
BIN_IDX_W shall propagate explicitly through the standalone and DE1-SoC telemetry instance boundaries.
Source-only checks shall not claim RTL compile, functional verification, Quartus compile, or hardware signoff.
Decode all 21 byte-address bits before forwarding the lower 12 bits to the CSR leaf.
Accept only aligned, full-width, little-endian, single-beat 32-bit transfers.
Never issue a CSR leaf request for an out-of-window or malformed Avalon request.
Permit at most one outstanding transaction and emit exactly one response for it.
Return DECODEERROR for an address outside the 4 KiB window and SLVERR for malformed or leaf-rejected accesses.
Return zero read data with every error response.
Use one read response for an illegal simultaneous read/write assertion: SLVERR in-window, or DECODEERROR when the address is also outside the window.
Count local_reject_pulse_o only for requests rejected before the CSR leaf.
Count adapter-local rejects through a dedicated CSR-bank input so concurrent external rejects do not coalesce them.
Do not claim board connectivity complete until generated HDL, SOPCINFO, Quartus compile, and hardware evidence exist.
Functional verification is intentionally deferred beyond Step 6.

invariants: ADC_CS_N is the legacy board alias for active-high LTC2308 CONVST and shall idle low.
This contract is limited to DE1-SoC Rev-H with LTC2308 and makes no cross-revision AD7928 or other ADC compatibility claim.
SLP remains zero in every supported command, so no reset-pin state or 200 ms sleep-wakeup path is assumed.
Every result is tagged by the previously shifted command; the first old-configuration result is never published as a new-channel sample.
After reset, disable, or abort, the wrapper shall wait at least 92 fabric cycles before accepting a new conversion request; an early request is rejected and sticky-attributed.
ADC_DOUT is synchronized before capture, while sample data and valid remain registered together in the 50 MHz fabric domain.
The ADC wrapper and adapter enter the source mux only through TSRC_ADC_LIVE and cannot bypass source selection.
BRAM replay remains the correctness and artifact-comparison authority and ADC completion cannot block BRAM replay or LINE-IN milestones.
Selecting the ADC profile does not establish native RTL behavior, Quartus timing closure, post-fit serial timing, analog fidelity, live ADC operation, or board evidence.

de1soc_audio_linein_contract.file_class: [1] hand-written Step-16 DE1-SoC LINE-IN audio contract
invariants: BRAM replay remains the correctness and artifact-comparison authority; LINE-IN is a live demonstration source.
The audio PLL creates only the codec master clock; CLOCK_50 remains the fabric and mathematical-core clock.
Codec activation occurs only after the 48 kHz, 16-bit I2S codec-master configuration writes have been acknowledged.
Audio payload CDC uses asynchronous FIFOs; independently synchronized payload bits are forbidden.
Audio RX overflow, TX overflow, and TX underflow counters remain separate from reserved CSR overflow bits.
Selecting the LINE-IN profile does not establish PLL lock, I2C acknowledgement, timing closure, live audio, or board evidence.

validation_rules: The physical board top shall instantiate each required board, Platform Designer, source/core, and telemetry/HPS owner exactly once.
The board hierarchy shall contain one mathematical core through trecap_source_core_integration and shall not instantiate the standalone core plus telemetry composition.
The generated Platform Designer CSR request and response channels shall bind through the hand-written wrapper to trecap_de1soc_full_top without a safe-idle substitute.
The DDR writer Avalon request and response channels shall bind through the hand-written wrapper to the generated F2SDRAM bridge without a safe-idle substitute.
Audio line-in samples and ADC capture samples shall enter trecap_source_core_integration through their real platform wrappers.
The mathematical core y stream shall remain always-accepted and shall also feed the best-effort audio line-out monitor; audio readiness shall never backpressure the mathematical core.

The LTC2308 wrapper shall drive a real six-bit next-configuration word, use a short active-high CONVST pulse from idle-low plus conversion-wait timing, clock twelve result bits, and discard the first old-configuration result after enable or channel change.

The synchronized switch-selected LTC2308 command shall latch on entry to TSRC_ADC_LIVE, remain stable for that source epoch, and require leave/re-enter plus re-prime before a new channel becomes sample-valid.
LTC2308 protocol cycle parameters shall be validated against CLK_HZ with overflow-safe wide-arithmetic assertions rather than relying only on literal default cycle values.
Core taps and authoritative counters shall pass directly from the source/core owner to the telemetry/HPS owner; the board top shall not synthesize replacement taps.
Telemetry and DDR backpressure shall not control source or mathematical-core readiness.
LEDR and HEX shall report real reset, activity, counter, transport, ring, and fault state instead of scaffold counters or constants.
The full DE1-SoC filelist and Quartus include shall list every hand-written owner in dependency order exactly once and shall exclude the standalone second-core composition.
CLOCK_50 shall be the only active fabric clock; sample, status, metrics, and heartbeat timing outputs shall be fractional-accumulator clock enables and shall never be used as clocks.
clock_reset_ctrl shall qualify KEY[0] release for 1000000 CLOCK_50 cycles, combine the qualified board release with h2f_reset_n exactly once, and own canonical rst_n_platform.
The physical board top shall consume canonical rst_n_platform directly and shall not create a second platform-reset synchronizer, pseudo clock domains, or pseudo per-domain resets.
The audio receive and transmit BCLK logic shall use separate asynchronous-assertion reset synchronizers whose releases occur on the respective positive and negative active edges.
clock_reset_ctrl shall not export synthetic frame/source-safe boundaries or claim a hardwired PLL lock in the direct CLOCK_50 baseline.
Audio line-out disable shall propagate into the BCLK domain so stale enabled samples cannot continue, while lineout-ready remains observability-only.
AUD_XCK shall come only from audio_pll_wrapper at 12.288 MHz; codec initialization and sample admission shall remain lock/config-done qualified and no ad-hoc divider is permitted.

Core y shall feed both audio channels through one sign-preserving left shift by AUDIO_SAMPLE_W minus T_SAMPLE_W; a derived scaled net is permitted only when its source is traceable to the real y_data output.
The Step-9 source checker establishes source structure only and shall not be presented as RTL compile, functional verification, Platform Designer generation, Quartus, timing, or hardware evidence.

de1soc_bram_replay_path_contract.file_class: [1] hand-written Step-11 BRAM replay path contract
validation_rules: The pin-agnostic Step-11 composition shall instantiate exactly one source/core integration owner and one logical telemetry/HPS owner, with no second mathematical core.

The Step-11 profile and reset default shall select TSRC_BRAM_REPLAY, while the pin-agnostic composition shall preserve the generated CSR source-mode commit path and shall not invent a hardware profile lock.

A raw explicit replay-start request shall reach the source owner independently of admission; admission shall require STATUS-only transport readiness, an idle writer with no queued FIFO record, and no E2E epoch in flight, and every denied explicit start shall emit reject evidence.

An accepted replay start shall flush only uncommitted packetizer/FIFO state through external_telemetry_flush_i; it shall never assert external_transport_clear_i or reset committed producer, consumer, or sequence state.

HPS TELEMETRY_SOFT_RESET shall remain transport-only under the frozen control contract; dedicated board KEY[3] shall abort and rearm only source/core/E2E state without flushing telemetry or changing writer/ring state, KEY[2] shall retain its frozen ADC manual-request role, and the next accepted replay may flush uncommitted telemetry only after transport_epoch_idle admission.
Periodic STATUS requests shall be suppressed while replay is busy; replay_path_done_pulse shall request the single replay-correlated post-core STATUS record used by the E2E supervisor.
replay_done_o shall retain the narrow source-token meaning and shall never be used by itself as exact end-to-end replay completion.

replay_path_done_o shall require replay_done_o, structural quiescence, every frozen Ny, tau_last, and Nframes count including the public core_error_sample_count and replay-epoch metric commit count, contiguous accepted y indices, and no replay/core fault, but shall cover only BRAM source through core y.

replay_e2e_done_o shall be the Step-11 end-to-end completion authority and shall require a new post-core-path STATUS record normal-committed to DDR, producer and DMA count advance, writer idle, and no replay/core/telemetry/DDR fault or drop.
An early source completion, undercount, overcount, repeated or skipped y index, mode change, or stage fault shall set completion error and shall never produce a false path-done result.
The failed replay epoch shall remain busy until explicit clear or reset so an error cannot silently turn into PASS or restart itself.
The board profile shall remain the zero_Ns4096_thr0 BRAM replay profile with Ns=4096, Ny=4608, Nframes=33, THR2=0, and STATUS-only telemetry.
The Step-11 RTL regression source shall use impulse_Ns1024_thr0 with Ns=1024, Ny=1536, Nframes=9, THR2=0, and the pin-agnostic replay-system top.

The impulse regression shall compare every accepted y sample and index, observe exact replay_path_done, then wait for replay_e2e_done after the STATUS DDR commit rather than treating source-done or core-path-done alone as full test completion.
The impulse regression shall rely exclusively on replay_path_done_pulse auto-injection for its post-core STATUS request and shall not manually pulse status_tick after path completion.
Real mathematical-core sample, frame, and unique-bin taps shall feed trecap_de1soc_full_top and trecap_telemetry_top without a synthetic replacement.
Telemetry records shall traverse the packet FIFO, HPS bridge, DDR ring writer, Avalon-MM write master, Platform Designer F2SDRAM boundary, and HPS DDR3 pins.

The Avalon-MM write master shall permit at most one outstanding beat and shall not emit record write-done until the final beat receives a successful response; the physical wrapper local OKAY proves only legal bridge acceptance because the generated F2SDRAM interface has no downstream response channel, while local range rejection shall return SLVERR and shall never advance the producer pointer.
The pin-agnostic Step-11 regression shall inject delayed OKAY and SLVERR beat responses and shall prove that a response error cannot produce a normal commit or E2E done.
Physical-board E2E completion shall mean successful local HPS/F2SDRAM bridge acceptance only and shall not be presented as physical DRAM durability or downstream DRAM error evidence.

The E2E supervisor shall latch faults and transport clear on both the accepted-start edge and the following baseline-capture cycle so no one-cycle failure can disappear through a baseline blind window.

replay_e2e_done shall be retained historical terminal evidence for its correlated replay/STATUS epoch rather than live global transport health; terminal success shall have no correlated Avalon-MM response outstanding.

A later unrelated periodic transport fault shall use the normal transport fault/status channels and shall not retroactively alter a completed epoch result; a new accepted epoch or the defined source/core clear/rearm shall invalidate the retained result.
Telemetry, packet FIFO, DDR writer, HPS, or Platform Designer backpressure shall never control source/core readiness or the mathematical y stream.
The physical board indicators shall distinguish source/core path completion from the stronger Step-11 telemetry-to-DDR end-to-end completion and shall never label replay_done as board PASS.
The uploaded reference archive SHA-256 is an observation only; the checked-in tree still records an unmatched embedded proxy with unverified source provenance.
Zero and impulse artifacts in this milestone are development-smoke inputs only and shall not be presented as reference-model signoff authority.
The source-only checker shall work without jsonschema and shall not invoke an RTL simulator, Platform Designer, Quartus, TimeQuest, or board hardware.
All RTL compile, functional, Platform Designer generation, Quartus, timing, hardware replay, DDR/HPS capture, and hardware-signoff evidence fields shall remain false until those gates actually run.

The active FPGA fabric shall use CLOCK_50 through clk_fabric as its only functional fabric clock; the peripheral audio PLL drives only AUD_XCK and does not create a core, telemetry, or HPS fabric domain.
clock_reset_ctrl shall require KEY[0] to remain high for 20 ms in the CLOCK_50 domain before board reset release becomes eligible.
The qualified board release and h2f_reset_n_i shall be combined exactly once inside clock_reset_ctrl before one final trecap_reset_sync instance.
The final trecap_reset_sync shall use at least two stages, assert rst_n_platform asynchronously, and release it synchronously in the CLOCK_50 domain.
The physical board top shall not add a second reset synchronizer or expose pseudo core, telemetry, or HPS-bridge clock/reset domains.
All shared-domain board integration modules shall consume clk_fabric and rst_n_platform; low-rate scheduler events shall remain clock enables, never derived clocks.
Sample, status, metrics, and heartbeat events shall use rational phase accumulators referenced to FABRIC_CLK_HZ for exact average rates of 48 kHz, 10 Hz, 30 Hz, and 2 Hz respectively.
The heartbeat state shall toggle on every 2 Hz heartbeat clock-enable pulse, producing a 1 Hz full waveform without creating another clock domain.
Telemetry soft reset shall remain a one-cycle synchronous clear/flush event and shall never gate, derive, or enter an asynchronous reset or event control.
The audio receive state shall release reset on AUD_BCLK positive edges and the audio transmit state shall release reset on AUD_BCLK negative edges.

AUD_XCK shall come only from the reviewed audio PLL source and codec initialization shall wait for qualified lock; live audio timing and hardware behavior remain unclaimed pending TimeQuest and board evidence.
ADC_SCLK shall remain a registered serial-protocol output driven by clk_fabric and shall never be used as an internal RTL clock.
The ADC continuous-request scheduler shall use an exact-average 100 kHz fractional phase accumulator; its interval may dither by at most one clk_fabric cycle.
The checked-in Platform Designer graph shall retain one 50 MHz clk_0 source and use clk_0.clk and clk_0.clk_reset for the typed CSR and F2SDRAM bridges.
The physical TimeQuest source shall constrain only CLOCK_50 at 20.000 ns; alternate board clocks, audio clocks, ADC generated clocks, and generated Platform Designer timing remain deferred.

The Step-10 checker establishes source structure only and shall not be presented as RTL compilation, functional verification, Platform Designer generation, Quartus compilation, timing closure, or hardware evidence.

scope: Complete repository source-tree snapshot through the selected architecture milestone. The enumerated exclusion policy removes known local caches, run/build outputs, vendor-generated Platform Designer products, simulator outputs, logs, and archive dumps.

validation_rules: Every normalized source shall enter trecap_core_top only through trecap_source_mux.
BRAM replay samples before tau_last feed analysis and samples from tau_last through Ny-1 feed only WOLA tail drain.
BRAM replay and diagnostic source handshakes shall be paced by source_tick_i.
The replay tail phase shall remain asserted while a selected tail token is held between source ticks.
A real source-mode change shall blank the stream, clear the source epoch, and issue a core discontinuity before the first new-source beat.
The public source discontinuity shall be a one-cycle event even though registered mux evidence extends the transition guard.
Datapath clear shall preserve the CSR-selected mux mode; shared rst_n is the coordinated source-mode reset.
An idempotent source-mode commit shall not clear or discontinuity-mark the stream.
A replay restart shall be accepted only when the selected BRAM source, core pipeline, and y output are quiescent.
A raw metrics-clear request shall be retained until a true core frame boundary or structural core idle boundary.
THR2 commit shall use the dedicated core-configuration safe boundary and never tap_frame_i.valid.
Core taps shall remain valid-only observation signals with no telemetry or DDR ready path into the core.
Only new-fault pulses with exact generated bit semantics may drive external_overflow_flags_set_i.
A delayed W1C owner-clear pulse shall re-arm the corresponding new-fault edge history.
Source/core and transport shall share clk_fabric and the already synchronized rst_n_platform in this implementation.
Replay done shall mean final source-token acceptance and shall not be represented as exact or quiescent core completion.
Source-only checks shall not claim RTL compile, functional verification, Quartus compile, live-source readiness, or hardware signoff.
